title.zh: 泛亞太區服務物流說明簡冊

parts.den: Part 1 establishes the purpose of service logistics, the path a spare part follows from demand to repair, and the three business models that define how brand owners and manufacturers divide their work.
parts.dzh: 第一篇說明服務物流之目的、備品自需求至維修之完整路徑，以及品牌商與代工廠分工所依據之三種營運模式。

parts.den: Part 2 introduces every company that appears in PAP service logistics: the brand owner, its after-sales subsidiary, the manufacturing partners, the former group companies, the current subsidiaries and the service partners in each country.
parts.dzh: 第二篇介紹 PAP 服務物流中出現之每一家企業：品牌商、售後服務子公司、代工夥伴、泛宏碁集團、集團子公司及各國服務夥伴。

parts.den: Part 3 describes Acer's global regions, the internal structure of PAP, the types of service sites, and the warehouse and local-assembly arrangements that support tenders.
parts.dzh: 第三篇說明宏碁之全球區域、PAP 內部組織、服務據點類型，以及支援標案之倉庫與當地組裝安排。

parts.en: HSN Group and the Process Change
parts.zh: 海柏特集團與流程調整
parts.den: Part 4 describes HSN Group as an organisation within PAP's operations and explains the supply change that takes effect on 1 December 2026.
parts.dzh: 第四篇說明 HSN 集團於 PAP 作業中之角色，以及 2026 年 12 月 1 日生效之供應流程調整。

parts.den: Part 5 covers the daily work of the PAP service logistics team: its functions, the systems it uses, the definition of the spare parts list and the maintenance of the Service BOM.
parts.dzh: 第五篇說明 PAP 服務物流團隊之日常工作：主要職能、使用系統、備品清單之定義流程與 Service BOM 之維護。

parts.den: Part 6 explains the structure of a service part number, provides graded decoding exercises and collects all region, subsidiary and HSN codes in one reference.
parts.dzh: 第六篇說明服務料號之結構，提供分級解析練習，並彙整區域、子公司與 HSN 代碼。

parts.den: Part 7 introduces every abbreviation and specialised term used in this guide, grouped by subject. Each entry gives the full name, the Chinese equivalent and the meaning in PAP operations.
parts.dzh: 第七篇依主題介紹本簡冊所有縮寫與專有名詞；每一條目列出全稱、中文名稱及於 PAP 作業中之意義。

parts.den: Part 8 contains review questions covering every part of the guide, followed by the answer key, the list of public sources and the verification register.
parts.dzh: 第八篇收錄涵蓋全冊之複習題、解答、公開資料來源及資料查證紀錄。
